record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Gible (1 star), Gabite (2 stars) and Garchomp (3 stars), all Dragon/Ground/Monster, maxPP 100, range 1, no passive, declare ABILITY DRAGON_BREATH.
record.summary: Directional breath. Deals flat SPECIAL damage (requested 25/50/100/200 by stars) to every enemy-team unit on the cells walked by effectInOrientation from the caster in one of 8 directions, limited to Chebyshev distance range + 1 = 2 from the caster. The direction is chosen by the sign of the target's offset (dx, dy), not an exact line to the target. Known helper exception: for RIGHT the loop is `x < board.rows` (6) although the production board has 8 columns and 6 rows, so the nominal two-cell ray is shortened: from a caster in column 3 or lower both cells are walked, from column 4 only column 5, from column 5 or beyond nothing. If no enemy is found on the walked cells (including when nothing is walked) the cast target itself is hit once by the helper's fallback; if an enemy was found, the fallback adds no extra hit (probe: caster (4,2), range 1, enemies (5,2) and (6,2), RIGHT -> only (5,2) receives a damage request).

targeting.who: every enemy-team unit (team different from the caster) on the walked cells within distance 2 in one of 8 directions; fallback: the cast target
targeting.note: Direction = board.orientation(caster, target): sign of dx and dy, so a target at a non-axis, non-45-degree offset yields a diagonal that may not contain it. The walk starts at the cell after the caster and runs to the board edge, but applyEffect skips cells whose Chebyshev distance to the caster is above maxRange (2). Allies are never damaged: the strategy's callback tests team !== caster team. The RIGHT case loops x < board.rows (6) although the board has 8 columns (see the BLAZE_KICK record), so a RIGHT-facing cast never visits columns 6 and 7: from a caster in column 4 only column 5 is reached, and from column 5 or beyond nothing is walked (the fallback then hits the cast target).

geometry.shape: ray of up to 2 cells in one of 8 directions from the caster (not a cone and not width 3); for RIGHT on the 8-column board the ray stops at column 5 (x < board.rows = 6)
geometry.detail: Cells at distance 1 and 2 along the direction are visited, in order; cells beyond are skipped by the maxRange check (the loop continues to the edge but does nothing). maxRange is pokemon.range + 1 and range is 1 for all three units, so 2. The fallback hits the target even if it lay outside the ray. RIGHT is the exception: its loop bound is board.rows (6), not board.columns (8), so columns 6 and 7 are never visited; the walked cells are columns caster+1 and caster+2 only while they are at most 5. LEFT and the other directions use the real bounds.

effects.target: each enemy on the walked cells (or the cast target by fallback)
effects.scaling: Requested amount = table value. handleSpecialDamage(damage, board, SPECIAL, caster, crit) with the default apBoost = true: damage + damage x AP/100, then x2 if the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE (consumed once per hit instance), x1.2 with the strange-steam board effect, then the crit multiplier only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault false). Each enemy receives one instance.
effects.resolution: Requested 25/50/100 is pre-defence. The target's special defence enters an intermediate division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x speDef), rounded up, minimum 1) that is not guaranteed final HP damage; shield damage counts in takenDamage (core-mechanics.md section A). Blocked by protect, skydiving, magicBounce (magicBounce reflects). The same per-enemy request is made whether the enemy was reached by the ray or by the fallback.

starBehavior.note: Caster stars index the damage table (1-4, fallback 200). Range stays 1, so the reach is always 2 cells.

record.positionalConditions: Enemies are hit only if they stand on the walked cells of the chosen direction within distance 2 (for RIGHT, only columns up to 5). If no enemy is found on the walked cells, only the cast target is hit (the helper's fallback), including when the target stands outside the shortened RIGHT ray or at a diagonal-ish offset; when at least one enemy was found the target gets no extra hit.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 25/50/100 special damage per enemy for 1/2/3 stars. Applied: AP percentage, DOUBLE_DAMAGE, strange steam and crit raise it before the target's special defence and shield; taken damage includes shield-absorbed damage, minimum 1 per hit. Which enemies receive a request depends on the walked cells: a RIGHT cast stops at column 5, and the cast target alone is requested when no enemy was found.
